INSTAGRAM
RAG for normal people: how to make AI answer from your own documents, with sources.

Ask ChatGPT about your refund policy and it guesses. Confidently.
RAG fixes that: search your docs first, hand the AI the relevant bits, make it answer only from those and quote where it found it.
No model training. Update a doc and it knows.

Comment RAG and I'll show you one I built, step by step.
